name: snake-mobile
description: P2P multiplayer snake game for mobile, built on Pear

scripts.bundle:bare: npx bare-pack --host ios-arm64 --host ios-arm64-simulator --host ios-x64-simulator --host android-arm64 --linked --out ./src/worker.bundle.js ./workers/main.js
scripts.bundle:react-native: npx react-native bundle --platform ios --dev false --entry-file index.ts --bundle-output out/ios/Snake/app.bundle --assets-dest out/ios/Snake && npx react-native bundle --platform android --dev false --entry-file index.ts --bundle-output out/android/Snake/app.bundle --assets-dest out/android/Snake
scripts.build: npx pear-build --ios-arm64 ./out/ios/Snake --ios-arm64-simulator ./out/ios/Snake --ios-x64-simulator ./out/ios/Snake --android-arm64 ./out/android/Snake --package ./package.json --target dist && cp -f pear.json dist/pear.json
scripts.update: npm run bundle:bare && npm run bundle:react-native && npm run build

author: Holepunch Inc
